prompt: Bob, another system administrator, has been given the task to manage Samba users' mappings. In the `user.map` file, he found an entry `!admin = root`. He is uncertain about the `!` character before the Windows username. What does the `!` character signify in the mapping file?
choices: It comments out the mapping line so it is ignored
It means the Windows user will have administrative privileges on Samba
It inverts the mapping so root is mapped to admin instead
It marks the mapping as case-insensitive
explanation: In the username map file the `!` character before an entry indicates that the Windows user gains administrative privileges on Samba.
